title: Sarah
summary: Sarah is dated in Raleigh's chronological table (1617), by a yeere of the World. Jones, Appendix F (23rd ed., 2026), dates this and sets the sort.
description: Added from the Raleigh import (The History of the World, 1617). Raleigh is display-only. He gives a yeere of the World, not a BC year, and Jones, Appendix F (23rd ed., 2026), dates this and sets the sort.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 1987 BC (no higher-tier year available).

calculated.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 783a
calculated.arithmetic: Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 2145. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 2145 = 1888 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad.

birth.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 278 (PDF p. 313)
birth.note: CONFLICT: Jones prints AM 2018 and 1987 BC. A derived check (not stored): 2018 + 1987 = 4005, not 4004, against his rule that a BC number added to its AM counterpart yields 4004. Both figures are stored as printed (first-printed rule). Neither was adjusted. The sort uses the printed BC year. Kevin ruled (2026-10-27) to use the first-printed figure and flag the conflict.

birth.citation: BLK SHP Scott, Dynasty of Slaves, Chapter 1, Trading His Sister for Safety
birth.note: He names Sarai at sixty-five. That is an age, not a calendar year. The verse he prints in this section is Genesis 12:16.

death.date: Sarai the wife of Abraham dyed this yeere .
death.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 783a
death.note: Year cell "2827 2145 62". The third printed figure 62 is the column "Promise", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682.

death.date: For Sarah died in the yeere of the world 2145.
death.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Book II, Part I, Chapter I, §. IV, sig. 160a–160b
death.note: Body intake. Her death, the yeere of the World. The chronological table already prints 2145 (sig. 783a). The same sentence says Isaac was borne in the yeere 2109, which does not say yeere of the World, and that figure is already the table row on isaac. year_bc_ad stays null. This does not change the sort.
